zh.headline: Anthropic 发布 Claude Fable 5.1 / Mythos 5.1
zh.observation: 今天最核心的信号是**前沿模型集体进入"安全-能力"再平衡期**：OpenAI 延迟 Astra 发布并首次赋予"关键"网络能力评级，Anthropic 推出 Mythos 受限版本与 Enterprise Frontier Safeguards，Google 则通过 Fairwind 项目限制 Cyber 版 Flash 的获取——安全已从合规话题变成产品分层策略。与此同时，**模型发布节奏呈现明显分化**：Anthropic 与 Google 密集迭代（Fable 5.1、Gemini 3.8 Flash），而 OpenAI 的 Astra 仍在延迟中，这为竞争格局留下了变数。另一个值得注意的趋势是**企业 AI 采购正在去英伟达化**，39.4% 的企业计划评估非英伟达加速器，这对整个 AI 基础设施供应链将产生深远影响。最后，World Labs Atlas 与 Qwen-Drive 的发布表明，**世界模型正从概念走向工程化**，3D 生成与自动驾驶的交叉地带可能是下一个主战场。

en.headline: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.1 / Mythos 5.1
en.observation: The dominant signal today is that **frontier labs have entered a collective "safety-capability" rebalancing phase**: OpenAI delayed Astra and granted it the first "Critical" cyber rating, Anthropic shipped Mythos restricted access plus Enterprise Frontier Safeguards, and Google gated Flash Cyber behind its Fairwind program — safety has shifted from compliance topic to product segmentation strategy. Meanwhile, **model release cadence shows clear divergence**: Anthropic and Google iterate densely (Fable 5.1, Gemini 3.8 Flash), while OpenAI's Astra remains delayed, leaving room for competitive shifts. Another notable trend is **enterprise AI procurement de-Nvidiation**, with 39.4% planning to evaluate non-Nvidia accelerators — a development with far-reaching implications for the AI infrastructure supply chain. Finally, World Labs' Atlas and Qwen-Drive's release suggest **world models are moving from concept to engineering**, and the intersection of 3D generation and autonomous driving may be the next major battleground.
